summary: Phase 2A provider-layer foundation verified end-to-end. Backend pytest = 83/83 passing (15 new unit tests in test_provider_layer.py + 6 new e2e tests in backend_test.py + 62 prior). Curl smoke against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL confirms exact response shapes for the new endpoints. Frontend ProvidersTab renders the 6 new modality cards with data-testid eff-mode-<modality> ('Mock') and eff-key-status-<modality> ('not configured') with zero console errors. No real-network imports in /app/backend/providers/.

endpoint_verification.POST /api/providers/test {modality:image: 200 -> ok=true, mode=mock, status=skipped, feature_flag_enabled=false, key_present=false, key_status=not_configured, message contains 'no real provider call'. PASS
endpoint_verification.GET /api/providers/{llm|image|video|voic: 200 -> mode=mock, would_use_real_provider=false, feature_flag_enabled=false, key_present=false on all 6. PASS
endpoint_verification.POST /api/scenes/{id}/segments: 200 -> full segment doc. Shape unchanged. PASS
endpoint_verification.POST /api/scenes/{id}/expand: 200 -> full segment doc with parent_segment_id. Shape unchanged. PASS

frontend_verification.ProvidersTab effective-global view: All 6 modality cards render. Visible rows: Provider, Model, Source, Mode='Mock', Key status='not configured'. data-testids eff-mode-llm/image/video/voice/music/export and eff-key-status-llm/image/video/voice/music/export all present.
frontend_verification.Mock-mode banner: Visible. All 6 USE_REAL_*_PROVIDER chips show OFF.
frontend_verification.Console errors/warnings: None observed during navigation Dashboard -> Project -> Providers tab.

critical_code_review_comments: executor.py cleanly enforces the Phase 2A invariant: even when USE_REAL_*_PROVIDER=true, the mock still runs because key_present() always returns False; status is then tagged 'blocked' with a transparent message. Good defensive design.
resolver.py priority order matches the spec (character -> project -> global -> hard-fallback); pure-function shape keeps unit tests trivial.
provider_status() and run_modality_test() share the same resolution path, so the dry-run endpoint cannot drift from real-execution metadata.
ProvidersTab.jsx EffectiveGlobalView additions are pure read-only rows; no state, no fetch, no input — zero regression surface.

PUT /api/projects/{id}/providers uses flat keys (image_provider, image_model). Worth a one-line API note for future agents — nested {image:{...}} payloads are silently ignored (Pydantic strips unknown fields).
Carry-over (non-blocking, from iter 2): DELETE /api/projects/{id} still does not cascade-delete segments whose scenes belong to the project. Not in scope for Phase 2A.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 modality cards rendered correctly, 0 console errors)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily toggled provider_override_enabled=true with image_provider=fal,image_model=flux-schnell on seeded project 49560a92 to verify project-resolved source. Reset to override_enabled=false with cleared fields at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest baseline is now 83 tests (cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q ~17s). New provider layer lives at /app/backend/providers/ — pure-logic, no real network. The new endpoints are POST /api/providers/test and GET /api/providers/{modality}/status. To exercise project-override resolution via /providers/test, set flat keys on the project via PUT /api/projects/{id}/providers (NOT nested under modality). Phase 2B will swap the mock dispatch in executor.execute_provider() when flag_on AND key_present() both true — keys.py is the single seam to update.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. Phase 2A behaves exactly as specified.
